slice: AVI stream existence/kind classification bounded exact proof
baseline_check: git merge-base --is-ancestor ef7ef452b9247791866bd65f3b987088502b26d1 HEAD exited 0; final fetch confirmed origin/main remained the same commit

input_domain.stream_types: fixed [[u8; 4]; 3]; each stream type covers all 2^32 bit patterns
input_domain.stream_no: full usize machine integer domain; not narrowed to production tag range 0..=99
input_domain.table_length: N=3 is explicit bounded model scope, not kani::assume input narrowing; minimum covering leading/middle/trailing selection, mixed auds/vids/other, and in/out-of-range lookup
input_domain.production_reparameterization: type-only table preserves hdrl order; scale/rate/start/length/sample_size/format are unobserved by the classification core

assume_classification: No kani::assume and no input narrowing. Fixed table length is explicit bounded model scope. No unwind depth reduction or unwinding-check disabling.

coverage.lookup_existence: lookup exists exactly for stream_no < 3 and preserves type bytes
coverage.type_class: exact auds/exact vids/other are disjoint and exhaustive
coverage.first_selection: first auds/vids equal first table-order match or absence without skipping earlier non-matches
coverage.kind_role: exact wb only audio payload; exact db/dc only video frames; all other kinds non-payload
coverage.packet_meaning: existing auds+wb audio payload, existing vids+db/dc video frame, other existing media packets timeline-only, missing/other streams no timeline slot
coverage.timeline_ownership: existing auds/vids own slots for every kind including pc/unknown; missing/other streams do not
coverage.selected_attribution: selected first-stream payload membership equals stream number equality plus payload role
coverage.oracle_independence: expected oracle classifies raw bytes directly and does not call production classification helpers
coverage.arithmetic_safety: overflow/underflow/panic freedom over the full symbolic input domain

production_connection: proof instantiates the same generic lightweight fcc_type view over a type-only table

initial_lane_before_mutation.note: initial cold-cache pass retained as auxiliary evidence; final canonical lane is kani/ after mutation revert

mutation.description: temporary production mutation included pc in the video-frame kind role: db/dc -> db/dc/pc
mutation.expected_detection: avi-stream-kind proof must fail; boundary-only/tag-only/entry/scan-only failures are not accepted as stream-kind oracle evidence
mutation.revert: mutation reverted exactly; final avi-stream-kind lane, mise run test al-media, and mise run test-formal passed after revert

unproven_scope.avi_movi_003_remainder: unbounded iteration termination, N+1 or longer entry sequences, real Vec<MoviPacket> accumulation, body slice/lifetime composition, nested walker composition, packet body boundary plus tag composition at iterator scale
unproven_scope.stream_declaration: longer stream tables, dynamic Vec<StreamHead>, strh/strf byte layout, strl ordering, missing strh declaration correspondence, format payload validation, AVI-STREAM-002
unproven_scope.avi_time_004: dwStart offset, u128 division, remainder, independent stream clocks, multi-packet accumulation
unproven_scope.integration: scan collection composition, Chunks iterator, I/O, allocation, real Vec decode, diagnostic formatting, public API whole-call no-panic, writer round-trip, corruption whole-call proof, partial ingest behavior
unproven_scope.other_containers: MP4-TABLE-005, MP4-PCM, signature reconstruction, and all MP4 properties outside regression proofs

limited_cost_comparison.scope: AVI movi/container walk related legacy whole-call proofs only; not the complete old/new cost matrix. Legacy numbers are read-only citations from evidence/al274-avi-movi-scan-proof/ledger.json
limited_cost_comparison.comparison_note: The legacy proofs include writer fixtures, container decode, allocation, formatting, and parser-wide branches and did not produce a formal pass. The new proof is narrower: fixed three-stream table plus one packet classification only. Lower rerun cost is not evidence of equivalent assurance.

proptest_overlap.added: small deterministic avi.rs regressions for classification lookup/selection/payload/ownership and packet_ticks missing/other/unknown-kind behavior; formal_containers.rs unchanged
proptest_overlap.relationship: proptest exercises public integration statistically; Kani proves fixed three-stream table plus one packet classification exhaustively over the full symbolic input domain

legacy_disposition: No legacy whole-call/container proof was retired in this slice. Retire decisions remain for a later slice with coordinator approval and replacement coverage.

heavy_property_remainders.AVI-MOVI-003 remainder: unbounded iteration termination, N+1 or longer sequences, real Vec accumulation, body slice composition, nested walker composition, and dynamic stream table composition remain
heavy_property_remainders.AVI-STREAM-002: strh/strf byte layout and declaration validation/correspondence require independent design
heavy_property_remainders.AVI-TIME-004: u128 division, remainder, dwStart, and multi-stream/packet accumulation require independent arithmetic models
heavy_property_remainders.AVI-PCM: WAVEFORMATEX validation and PCM conversion need shared-or-container-specific boundary design
heavy_property_remainders.MP4-TABLE-005: sample table accumulation, Vec expansion, and cross-table consistency require separate arithmetic boundaries
heavy_property_remainders.MP4-PCM: codec matrix, width/endian/sign conversion, and data-layer observations remain
heavy_property_remainders.signature_reconstruction: small but marginal because detect_format_signature_rules already passes
